lines.en: Karaku drifts forward lazily.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚，在草上蹭出声。
lines.en: I drag my feet through the grass.
Its skin glitters under the sun.
Watch out, Mugen Corps members.

lines.zh: 可乐的影子在地面上移动。
lines.en: Karaku's shadow moves on the ground.
It follows your scent.
Karaku seeks a new target.

lines.zh: 阳光下，它的翅膀反射光芒。
lines.en: Its wings reflect sunlight.
It avoids the sunlight.
Karaku moves slowly in the air.
I slide along under the eaves.
Silent steps, only a shadow left.
It hangs suspended in the air.
Its eyes look hollow.
It floats silently.
It looks even paler under the sun.
Its wings tremble slightly.
Its presence is faint.
Karaku seems to ponder something.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤在阳光下反射。
lines.en: Its skin reflects under the sun.
It turns slowly.
Karaku waits for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，眼睛发出红光。
lines.en: Its eyes glow red, staring at you.

lines.zh: 可乐的视线锁定在你身上。
lines.en: Its gaze locks onto you.

lines.zh: 它似乎闻到了你的气味。
lines.en: It seems to smell your scent.
Its head turns to you.

lines.zh: 扇子一扇，风就把你掀翻。
lines.en: One fan sweep and the wind flips you over.

lines.zh: 可乐的翅膀紧贴着身体。
lines.en: Its wings cling to its body.
It searches for your weakness.

lines.zh: 可乐的影子在你周围舞动。
lines.en: Its shadow dances around you.
Its gaze is sharp as a blade.
It's ready to attack.

lines.zh: 可乐受了伤，声音虚弱了。
lines.en: Karaku is hurt, its voice weakens.
Karaku is injured, its movement slows.

lines.zh: 可乐身上有伤，叫声低沉。
lines.en: Karaku's injured, its cry is low.

lines.zh: 可乐受了伤，声音沙哑了。
lines.en: Karaku's voice is hoarse from its wounds.

lines.zh: 可乐身上破了皮，声音发抖。
lines.en: Karaku's voice trembles as its skin is torn.
Karaku's injured, its cry is sorrowful.
Karaku is injured, its movement is hard.
Karaku's voice is raspy from its injuries.
Karaku's voice sizzles from its wounds.
Karaku's voice is hoarse from its injuries.
Rumble, so hungry!

lines.zh: 闻到你的味道，我要吃掉你！
lines.en: Smell you, gotta eat you!

lines.zh: 你身上的气息，很适合血鬼术！
lines.en: Your aura, perfect for blood magic!

lines.zh: 阳光不会伤我，但会削弱我！
lines.en: Sun weakens me, not harms me!
Mukasa member, taste me!
Your blood, feeds me!
Away from sun, I chase!
Karaku, mine!
Clone, boosts power!
Mukasa, eat together!
Weak, one hit kill!
Sun weakens me!
Avoid sun, fight on!
Clone attacks, too!
Half power in sun!
Stay back, beware clones!
Clones wander, beware!
Sun, I hide!

lines.zh: 你的攻击无效，我有护甲！
lines.en: Your attack fails, I have armor!
Mukasa, I fear not!
Find mate, stronger!
Mate, fight Mukasa!
Mate, source of power!
Together against Mukasa!
Mate, my strength source!

lines.zh: 找到同类，我的力量加倍！
lines.en: Mate found, power doubles!
Mate, I need you!
Mate, my power source!
Mate, fight together!
Mate, my strength lies there!

lines.zh: 可乐发出嘶嘶声，盯着你，似乎在考虑是否要咬你一口。
lines.en: Kakku hisses, staring at you, considering biting you.

lines.zh: 可乐舔了舔嘴唇，露出凶狠的目光。
lines.en: Kakku licks his lips, giving you a fierce look.

lines.zh: 你看到了可乐口中锋利的獠牙。
lines.en: You see Kakku's sharp fangs.

lines.zh: 可乐盯着你，眼中充满杀意。
lines.en: Kakku stares at you, his eyes filled with malice.

lines.zh: 可乐发出低沉的咆哮，准备攻击。
lines.en: Kakku rumbles, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 可乐的双眼闪烁着血红色的光芒。
lines.en: Kakku's eyes glow blood red.

lines.zh: 你闻到了可乐身上散发的腐烂气味。
lines.en: You smell the rotting scent from Kakku.

lines.zh: 可乐张开血盆大口，露出尖牙。
lines.en: Kakku opens his bloody mouth, showing sharp fangs.

lines.zh: 可乐的叫声中带着一丝饥饿。
lines.en: Kakku's growl hints at hunger.

lines.zh: 可乐在你周围徘徊，寻找机会。
lines.en: Kakku circles around you, looking for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 可乐锁定目标，发出闷哼声。
lines.en: Kakku snorts as he locks onto his target.

lines.zh: 可乐的双眼锁定你，准备攻击。
lines.en: Kakku locks onto you with his eyes, ready to attack.
Kakku growls, locking onto you.

lines.zh: 可乐盯紧目标，似乎要一击毙命。
lines.en: Kakku fixes his gaze on the target, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 可乐的呼吸变得急促，锁定你。
lines.en: Kakku's breathing quickens as he locks onto you.

lines.zh: 可乐的目光锐利，锁定你。
lines.en: Kakku's sharp gaze locks onto you.

lines.zh: 可乐的瞳孔放大，锁定你。
lines.en: Kakku's pupils dilate, locking onto you.

lines.zh: 可乐的爪子紧绷，锁定你。
lines.en: Kakku's claws tense, locking onto you.

lines.zh: 可乐开始追踪你，锁定你。
lines.en: Kakku begins tracking you, locking onto you.

lines.zh: 可乐的双眼变得凶狠，锁定你。
lines.en: Kakku's eyes turn fierce, locking onto you.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的队服，我不会认错
lines.en: Demon Slayer uniform. I know it anywhere.
Your blade isn't even drawn yet.
My Blood Demon Art coils around your feet.
If I move first, you lose.
The smell of that uniform rides the wind.

lines.zh: 可乐紧盯着你，仿佛要把你吞掉。
lines.en: Kakku stares at you like he's going to devour you.

lines.zh: 可乐的瞳孔紧缩，瞄准你。
lines.en: Kakku narrows his eyes, aiming at you.

lines.zh: 可乐的爪子收紧，准备攻击你。
lines.en: Kakku tightens his claws, ready to attack you.

lines.zh: 可乐的叫声中带着威胁。
lines.en: Kakku's growl carries a threat.

lines.zh: 可乐的呼吸变得沉重，瞄准你。
lines.en: Kakku's breathing grows heavy, aiming at you.

lines.zh: 可乐的双眼闪烁着杀意，瞄准你。
lines.en: Kakku's eyes glow with malice, aiming at you.

lines.zh: 可乐的爪子在你身上扫过，锁定你。
lines.en: Kakku's claws sweep over you, locking onto you.

lines.zh: 可乐的嘶嘶声中带着攻击欲望。
lines.en: Kakku's hiss carries an attack urge.

lines.zh: 可乐的双眼紧盯着你，准备攻击。
lines.en: Kakku's eyes are locked on you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 可乐的爪子准备好，瞄准你。
lines.en: Kakku's claws are ready, aiming at you.
I raise my fan and the wind cuts.

lines.zh: 血鬼术从你脚下长出来
lines.en: My art grows up from under your feet.
I slip into shadow where you can't find me.
Don't look up. That's me on the eaves.
A wind blade circles behind you.

lines.zh: 我等你举刀，那一下最空
lines.en: I wait for your swing. That's your opening.
Fan spread wide, this patch is mine.
Your back is to the sun. Perfect.
I have more bodies than you.
One, two, three. Here comes the wind.
Screams and lunges at the enemy!
Bites at the enemy's throat!
Swings claws to attack!
My fan sends out a wind blade.
Lashes out with a powerful claw!
Dodges sunlight!
Flaps wings to approach!
Jumps over the enemy!
Uses wings to block attacks!
Hisses and advances!
My fan ribs crack your wrist.
A wind blade splits your sleeve.
I drive a foot into your chest.

lines.zh: 贴地滑过去，抓你的脚踝
lines.en: I skim low and grab your ankle.
My claws are quicker than your blade.
This fan stroke flips you over.
My art presses at your throat.
I stab in from your flank.
Splits into four Kakus!
Jumps out of the darkness to attack!
Rises from the ground!
Born under moonlight!
Crawls out from the fissure!
Appears from the shadows!
Hatches from the ruins!
Crawls out of the decaying earth!
Pokes out from the pile of corpses!
Born in the night!

lines.zh: 半天狗倒下时，我站起来
lines.en: When Hantengu falls, I rise.
I tear free of my father's ruined body.
Four of me touch down at once.
My face forms first in the shadow.

lines.zh: 可乐中了火焰，惨叫一声。
lines.en: Karaku cries out from the fire.

lines.zh: 可乐从高处跌落，痛苦哀鸣。
lines.en: Karaku moans in pain after a fall.

lines.zh: 可乐被水淹没，嘶嘶作响。
lines.en: Karaku hisses as it drowns.

lines.zh: 可乐被爆炸击中，惨叫一声。
lines.en: Karaku cries out from the explosion.

lines.zh: 可乐被箭矢击中，惨叫一声。
lines.en: Karaku cries out from a projectile.

lines.zh: 可乐被魔法击中，惨叫一声。
lines.en: Karaku cries out from magic.

lines.zh: 可乐饥饿难耐，声音凄厉。
lines.en: Karaku's voice is harsh from starvation.

lines.zh: 可乐被闪电击中，惨叫一声。
lines.en: Karaku cries out from lightning.

lines.zh: 可乐跌入虚无，惨叫一声。
lines.en: Karaku cries out as it falls into the void.
